entities.summary: Eddie Lee Wilkins is an American former basketball player. A 6'10" power forward/center who played college basketball for the Gardner–Webb Runnin' Bulldogs, Wilkins played professionally for nine seasons in Italy, Spain and the United States, include six seasons in the NBA for the New York Knicks and the Philadelphia 76ers.
